assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and is being evaluated for potential arrhythmias given a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The service is associated with diagnosis code Z86.73.
The service is associated with diagnosis code R00.2.
